name: Amir's cone
pipeline: img2threejs (order followed by hand; forge/*.py gates could not run, no Python 3 on this machine)

statedApproximations: Hand, paper sleeve and plastic spoon from the reference are deliberately absent: the page needs the cone alone on a flat field.
Undersides and the rear of the cone are inferred from a single view.
Ice cream is a surface approximation with sheen and a low clearcoat, not true subsurface scattering.

components.topologyRationale: A surface of revolution with a periodic relief field; a box or a stock ConeGeometry cannot carry the lattice in the silhouette.
localFeatures: diamond waffle lattice, 18 cells around by 14 down, relief falling off toward the tip
toast gradient baked to vertex colour, ridge crowns darker than valleys

components.topologyRationale: A flared collar with a scalloped outer edge and a vertical wave; double-sided, no thickness.
A displaced sphere; the shear line is a deformation of one surface, not a seam between two.
localFeatures: horizontal shear line from the scoop tool

components.topologyRationale: Same, at a higher noise amplitude: the torn cauliflower surface is the identity feature.

localFeatures: seeded sampling on the upper scoop surface
hidden for flavours with no bits

lighting.key: warm directional from the upper left, intensity 2.4
lighting.fill: hemisphere, sand above and cobalt below, to tie the model to the page
lighting.rim: cool directional from behind right, intensity 0.9
lighting.environment: procedural gradient canvas through PMREMGenerator; no external HDR

pivots.scoopUpper: its own centre, so a flavour change can scale it in

actionReady.explodable: every part is a named child of the root group, listed in userData.parts
actionReady.clickable: each part mesh carries userData.partId and is raycastable
actionReady.interaction: setFlavour(id) pushes the chosen flavour onto the top scoop and slides the previous one down
